passages.title: Language Exchange Club
paras: The club meets every other Wednesday evening. Most activities are organised in pairs so each member gets speaking time.
Beginners are welcome to bring a bilingual dictionary. During activities, members are encouraged to use the language they are learning.
There is no membership fee, but registration is required. Children are welcome when accompanied by a responsible adult.
A list of conversation topics is emailed before each meeting. Members may suggest themes for future sessions.

passages.title: Outdoor Equipment Hire
paras: Equipment hired for the weekend must be returned by 5 p.m. on Sunday. Customers must show photo identification when collecting equipment.
A helmet is included at no extra charge with every bicycle hire. Customers must report damage as soon as they notice it.
A cleaning fee may be charged if equipment is returned excessively muddy. Bookings can be cancelled without charge up to 24 hours before collection.
Deposits are returned after staff inspect the equipment. Hire services pause during official severe weather warnings.

passages.title: Community Food Pantry
passages.intro: Local services, rules and practical arrangements
paras: Each household may use the pantry once every two weeks. Visitors are asked to provide proof that they live in the service area.
Fresh produce varies according to the donations received. Appointments are preferred, although walk-ins may be served if supplies permit.
Visitors should tell staff about food allergies when registering. The pantry cannot guarantee any particular brand of food.
Delivery may be arranged for approved clients who cannot leave home. Friday opening hours end at noon.
